overallAssessment: The Belfort persona moved through BCSM stages faster than any other persona — but that speed created a trust deficit that showed up in the close. The procedural-vs-political reframe in Stage 3 was the session's strongest individual move. Stage 2: after Bato discloses a fear, reflect it back before solving it
